title: SBOM, potpisi i SLSA
summary: SBOM (CycloneDX, SPDX) za digest slike sa Syftom i Trivyjem, potpis cosignom v3 sa ključem i keyless, in-toto atestacije i SLSA provenance, te provjera potpisa prije deploya i Kyverno ImageValidatingPolicy u klasteru.
summary_en: SBOMs (CycloneDX, SPDX) for an image digest with Syft and Trivy, signing with cosign v3 using a key and keyless, in-toto attestations and SLSA provenance, verifying signatures before deploy, and Kyverno ImageValidatingPolicy in the cluster.
